purpose: Lubiprostone helps relieve constipation by making it easier for you to have a bowel movement. It is used for adults with chronic constipation, irritable bowel syndrome with constipation (IBS-C), and constipation caused by opioid pain medications. It works to reduce straining, bloating, and discomfort related to constipation.
how_it_works: Lubiprostone works by activating tiny channels in the lining of your intestines that allow chloride and water to flow into your gut. This extra fluid softens your stool and helps it move more easily through your intestines. Think of it like adding a lubricant to your digestive tract to get things moving again.
common_side_effects: Nausea is the most common side effect, especially when first starting the medication. You may also experience diarrhea, stomach pain or discomfort, headache, bloating, or gas. Taking the medication with food and water can help reduce nausea.
warnings: Do not take lubiprostone if you have a blockage in your digestive tract, as it could be dangerous. Women who are pregnant or planning to become pregnant should talk to their doctor before using this medication, as it may cause harm to an unborn baby. If you experience severe diarrhea, stop taking it and contact your doctor. It is approved only for women for IBS-C and is not recommended for children.
typical_dosing: For chronic constipation, the usual dose is 24 micrograms taken by mouth twice a day with food and water. For IBS-C in women, the typical dose is 8 micrograms twice a day with food and water. For opioid-induced constipation, the dose is 24 micrograms twice daily with food and water. Always follow your doctor's specific instructions.
